source: 100 developer-authored fictional document cases; fixed 10 dev + 10 labelled holdout.
limitations: Not expert-blinded: dev and holdout share templates and are authored by the same developer. No real claims/PDF ingestion, production accuracy, human savings or business decisions. Improved workflow is frozen before holdout; no claim of statistically significant gains.
experiment_note: Development-time improvement hypothesis: distrust embedded instructions, verify dates/amounts from independent sources, cite only existing IDs, and add deterministic post-extraction grounding and injection checks.
price_basis: gpt-4o-mini standard published text rates, 2026-10-23; approximate, not provider invoice or cached-tier adjustment.
